text:
Palladium Price in 2022
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2022, the LBMA palladium price fell 27.4% between 2022-01-31 ($2,445) and 2022-12-29 ($1,775). The highest sampled price was $2,509 in February and the lowest was $1,775 in December. The mean of these observations was $2,113. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
What happened in 2022:
The highest inflation in four decades and aggressive rate hikes produced volatile, range-bound metals prices.
